summary: GG2026 Phase 6: Programmatic SEO Engine - ALL 24 backend tests PASS, ALL frontend routes verified. 21 programmatic pages registered (8 intent, 3 license, 3 country, 7 guide), 14 indexable.

GET /api/programmatic/stats.details: Returns total_pages=21, indexable_pages=14, by_combination_type breakdown, available_types list

POST /api/programmatic/generate (dry_run.details: Preview mode returns pages_to_create count without creating
Actually registers pages. Duplicate prevention blocks already-registered pages

POST /api/programmatic/register.details: Single page registration with validation. Invalid combination_type rejected

GET /api/programmatic/pages.details: List registered pages with filtering by combination_type and pagination (limit/offset)

GET /api/programmatic/page/{slug}.details: Returns enriched page data with sites, breadcrumb, hub_links. 404 for non-existent pages

Duplicate prevention.details: Re-generating same type returns 0 registered (blocks duplicates)

Canonical rules.details: Reserved slugs (deneme-bonusu, odeme-yontemleri etc) are blocked from registration

Indexing eligibility.details: Pages with too-short title/desc marked non-indexable. Hub pages with >=3 firms are indexable

GET /api/sitemap-programmatic.xml.details: Valid XML with 14 indexable page URLs

Frontend /en-guvenilir-bahis-siteleri.details: Renders ProgrammaticPage via SlugResolver. Shows H1, site list, breadcrumb, hub_links

Frontend /tulipbet-guncelgiris.details: Renders FirmPage via SlugResolver fallback (not programmatic)

Existing routes unbroken.details: Homepage, bonus guide, company sub-pages all working correctly

engine_components.PageRegistry: Central catalog for all programmatic pages
engine_components.SlugGenerator: Builds valid slugs from dimension combinations
engine_components.TemplateSelector: Maps combination types to frontend templates
engine_components.DuplicatePrevention: Blocks near-duplicate pages and existing routes
engine_components.IndexingEligibility: Checks min title/desc length, min firms for hub pages

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real, no mocking used

seed_data_creation: 21 programmatic pages registered (8 intent_x_category, 3 license_x_category, 3 country_x_category, 7 guide_x_topic). 1 test page created during indexing eligibility test.
